input: Build a emergency go-bag for natural disasters

gold.taskTitle: Build a Natural Disaster Emergency Go-Bag
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to assemble a ready-to-go emergency bag stocked for natural disaster scenarios.

questions.title: Which natural disasters are most likely in your area?
questions.description: Identify the specific disaster types (earthquake, hurricane, wildfire, flood, tornado, etc.) the bag needs to be optimized for.

questions.title: How many people does this go-bag need to cover?
questions.description: Determine the number of adults, children, and/or pets so supplies can be scaled appropriately.

questions.title: How many days of self-sufficiency should the bag support?
questions.description: Clarify the target duration (72 hours is standard, but some prefer 7-14 days) to size food, water, and medical supplies.

questions.title: Do any household members have medical or dietary needs?
questions.description: Capture any prescription medications, allergies, mobility limitations, or special dietary requirements that must be packed.

questions.title: What is your budget for building this go-bag?
questions.description: Understand spending constraints so the plan can prioritize essentials or recommend premium gear accordingly.

questions.title: Do you already own any gear intended for the bag?
questions.description: Find out what items (flashlights, first-aid kits, water filters, etc.) are already on hand to avoid duplicate purchases.

questions.title: Will you carry the bag on foot or transport it by vehicle?
questions.description: Determine the primary evacuation method so weight, size, and bag type (backpack vs. duffel) can be matched to real-world use.
